title: HEAR ROSE × SAFE WORD RABBIT (VDS Mansion 808 Edit) [140]
style: trap-soul mansion edit, 140 BPM half-time feel, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), deep 808 sub with slide notes, dusty boom-bap drums, gospel-style chopped female vocal stacks pitched +6, grounded male chops at -4, vinyl crackle, Rhodes piano motif, tape-saturated pads, finger snaps and rim shots, lush mansion-room reverb, sidechain ducking on 808 hits, late-night mood, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(vinyl crackle, Rhodes chord swells)
(HEAR — ROSE...)
(safe... word... rabbit...)
(VDS — MAN — SION...)

[Build]
(808 slide enters, hats triplet up)
HEAR ROSE? HEAR ROSE?
SAFE — WORD — RABBIT!
HEAR ROSE? HEAR ROSE?
KEEL — HOLDS — THE — ROOM!
(snap roll, sub wobble)

[Drop 1]
(808 hits hard, half-time pocket)
HEAR — ROSE!
SAFE — WORD!
RAB — BIT!
MAN — SION — 808!
(gospel chop stack +7) yes-yes-yes-yes
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(Rhodes leads, chops trade left-right)
(hear?) (rose?) (now?)
(safe!) (word!) (go!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE KEY —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to Rhodes + sub pulse)
(whispered) hear... rose...
(soft) safe... word... rabbit...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(tape hiss builds)

[Drop 2]
(808 doubles, gospel stack peak)
HEAR — ROSE! (yes yes yes!)
SAFE — WORD! (rab-bit rab-bit!)
MAN — SION — 808!
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(808 fades, vinyl crackle returns)
(hear... rose...)
(safe... word... rabbit...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(Rhodes resolves to silence)
